image_description: A close-up photograph of a cluster of white daisies with bright yellow centers against a blurred green background. There are four prominent flower heads visible: one in the bottom left, one in the bottom center, one on the right, and two overlapping in the top center. The flowers exhibit classic daisy morphology with white ray petals and yellow disc florets.
